login.title: Log in
login.description: Log in to see the events you created and to connect your calendar.
login.ssoFailed: Could not start single sign-on. Please try again later.
login.invalid: The email/username or password is incorrect.
login.required: Enter your email (or username) and password.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: With an account you can manage all your events in one place and connect your calendar.
register.usernameHelp: Letters, digits and @ . + - _ only. You can also log in with it.
register.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters; avoid anything easy to guess.

callback.denied: Sign-in was cancelled or the identity provider returned an error.
callback.missingCode: The identity provider sent an invalid response. Please log in again.
callback.invalidState: The sign-in request expired or is invalid. Please log in again.
